devBuild.title: Development build needed
devBuild.body: Health Connect isn’t available in Expo Go — run a development build to test this.

installHealthConnect.title: Install Health Connect
installHealthConnect.body: Health Connect lets POWR read your phone's step & activity data. It's a free Google app — install it and come back here to connect.

onboarding.headline: This is how POWR <gold>counts your movement.</gold>
onboarding.subhead: Steps, workouts and sleep flow in from your phone, so every move earns automatically.
onboarding.subheadWithWearable: Your watch covers workouts — your phone covers steps. You need both to earn everything.

picker.title: Pick your primary source
picker.body: You've connected more than one. Choose which POWR should use as the source of truth for points.

samsung.title: Connect Samsung Health
samsung.body: Samsung Health shares your workouts, steps & sleep through Health Connect. Two quick steps:
samsung.step1Desc: POWR reads your data from Health Connect
samsung.step2Title: 2. Turn on sharing in Samsung Health
samsung.step2Desc: Samsung Health → Settings → Health Connect → allow

scene.sourcesIos: Apple Watch + anything that writes to Apple Health
scene.sourcesAndroid: Google Fit, Galaxy & Pixel Watch & more

viaPhone.readsFrom: POWR reads your {{brand}} data from it

web.title: {{brand}} syncs through your phone
web.body: Our direct {{brand}} link is paused for now. Open POWR on your phone to connect Apple Health or Health Connect. Your {{brand}} data reaches POWR from there.

unsupported.titleIos: {{brand}} can’t sync to iPhone right now
unsupported.titleAndroid: {{brand}} can’t sync to this phone right now
unsupported.body: Our direct {{brand}} link is paused, and {{brand}} doesn’t share with {{store}}. Until it’s back, POWR counts the steps your phone records — connect {{store}} for those.

viaPhoneSteps.title: {{brand}} syncs through {{store}}
viaPhoneSteps.body: Our direct {{brand}} link is paused for now. Your {{brand}} still earns POWR: {{app}} shares your workouts, steps and sleep with {{store}}, and POWR reads them from there.
viaPhoneSteps.step2Generic: In {{app}}, find its {{store}} setting (usually under Settings → Connected apps) and allow everything

garmin.ios: Garmin Connect → More → Settings → Connected Apps → Apple Health, then allow everything
garmin.android: Garmin Connect → Settings → Health Connect, then allow everything
garmin.note: Open Garmin Connect once a day — it only shares while it’s open.

whoop.ios: WHOOP → More → App Settings → Integrations → Apple Health → Connect, then allow everything
whoop.android: WHOOP → More → App Settings → Integrations → Health Connect, then allow everything

oura.ios: Oura → menu → Settings → Apple Health, then turn on Connect to Health
oura.android: Oura → menu → Settings → Health Connect, then allow everything

polar.ios: Polar Flow → More → General settings → Apple Health, then Turn All Categories On
polar.android: Polar Flow → More → General settings → Health Connect, then allow everything

strava.ios: Strava → Settings → Applications, Services, and Devices → Health → Connect, and turn on Workouts
strava.android: Strava → Settings → Applications, Services, and Devices → Health Connect

zepp.ios: Zepp → Profile → Add accounts → Apple Health, then allow everything
zepp.android: Zepp → Profile → Link third-party accounts → Health Connect, then turn on sync

fitbit.android: Fitbit → your profile → Settings → Health Connect → Sync with Health Connect
